products.name: Airtable
products.description: Leading no-code database platform with spreadsheet interface, relational records, and rich ecosystem. Serves 500k+ organizations including 80% of Fortune 100.
products.positioning: Market leader in no-code databases; trusted by enterprises for flexibility, ease of use, and ecosystem breadth

products.name: Baserow
products.description: Open-source no-code database platform with self-hosting option. Emphasizes data sovereignty, GDPR/HIPAA/SOC2 compliance, and generous free tier with unlimited databases.
products.positioning: Open-source Airtable alternative for privacy-conscious teams; self-hosting removes all usage limits

products.name: NocoDB
products.description: Open-source platform that transforms existing SQL databases into collaborative no-code apps. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MSSQL, Oracle, and data warehouse connectors.
products.positioning: Best self-hosted Airtable alternative for teams with existing SQL databases; supports multiple views and automation

products.name: Grist
products.description: Open-source spreadsheet-database hybrid with Python formula support, relational tables, and SQLite foundation. Focused on regulated industries and data portability.
products.positioning: Evolution of spreadsheets with database structure; Python power for data professionals; excellent for compliance-heavy workflows

products.name: Teable
products.description: PostgreSQL-powered no-code platform with AI talk-to-build feature, multiple views, and unlimited rows on self-hosted. ISO9001/27001 certified.
products.positioning: Modern AI-enhanced Airtable alternative; optimized for performance with large datasets; focus on developer experience

products.name: Knack
products.description: AI-powered no-code app builder focused on complete business applications. Generates full-featured apps with databases, forms, dashboards, and automation in minutes.
products.positioning: No-code app platform for non-technical builders; AI generates apps; emphasis on business workflow automation and e-commerce

products.name: Smartsheet
products.description: Enterprise collaboration platform combining spreadsheet grid with Gantt charts, resource management, and project tracking. Strong automation and reporting.
products.positioning: Enterprise collaboration and project management; combines spreadsheet usability with project workflow features

product_features.hci_cost_note: Intuitive linked records and field type picker; one-click relationship definition
product_features.notes: Market-leading relational data modeling with linked records, lookups, and rollups. 500+ field types through extensions.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Grid, form, calendar, kanban, gallery, timeline all accessible from same toolbar
product_features.notes: Five primary view types plus extensions. Each view maintains independent filters and sorts.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Formula editor requires Excel-like syntax learning; limited to proprietary function set
product_features.notes: Excel-style formulas with 100+ functions. Does not support custom code or full programming logic.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Role-based permissions UI is powerful but has learning curve; users confuse permissions model
product_features.notes: Owner, Creator, Editor, Commenter roles. Team plan: 5 editors max on free tier. Workspace-level and base-level permissions.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Visual filter builder with drag-and-drop operators; no code required
product_features.notes: Visual query builder for filters, sorts, and grouped views. API-first design enables complex queries.

product_features.hci_cost_note: REST API rate-limited (5 req/sec); requires understanding of tokens and webhooks
product_features.notes: REST Web API with 100k calls/month on Team plan. Extensions ecosystem enables no-code integrations.

product_features.hci_cost_note: AI chat available in sidebar; limited to content generation and field suggestions
product_features.notes: Omni AI feature with monthly credits. Helps with writing, formula generation, data exploration.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Known lag with 50k+ records; slow performance on large grids cited in reviews
product_features.notes: 50k records per base limit on Team plan. Performance degrades with large record counts and complex views.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Similar to Airtable with intuitive linked records interface
product_features.notes: Full relational support: one-to-many, many-to-many links, lookups, rollups.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Grid, gallery, kanban, form views; accessible and consistent
product_features.notes: Four primary view types. Free tier limits kanban/gallery; premium includes all views.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Docker Compose setup is straightforward but requires server management skills
product_features.notes: Core differentiator: unlimited rows, storage, users when self-hosted. Free tier on-prem includes all features.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Role-based permissions available on free self-hosted tier
product_features.notes: Owner, Creator, Editor, Commenter roles. Free plan allows unlimited collaborators read-only; paid allows editors.

product_features.hci_cost_note: GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2 certifications built-in at no extra cost
product_features.notes: Data sovereignty and compliance are major selling points vs Airtable.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Auto-generated REST API per table; field names cryptic per reviews
product_features.notes: REST API with auto-generated endpoints. Webhooks for automations. API tokens available on self-hosted.

product_features.hci_cost_note: No native mobile app; web responsive but not optimized
product_features.notes: Major gap vs Airtable and NocoDB which have iOS/Android apps.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Simple connection string UI but requires SQL database knowledge
product_features.notes: Connects to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MSSQL, Oracle, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Databricks. No data duplication.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Grid, form, kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline all default included
product_features.notes: Six view types including Timeline. Outperforms Baserow and matches Airtable on view variety.

product_features.hci_cost_note: REST API + webhooks; integrates well with n8n and external automation tools
product_features.notes: Webhooks with detailed trigger/action parameters. API tokens in free tier. Excellent for power users.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Group-based permissions included free tier (unique advantage)
product_features.notes: Creator, Editor, Commenter, Viewer roles. Free tier supports group permissions, unique among competitors.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Row-level comments supported
product_features.notes: Supports record comments on free tier. Self-hosted lacks @ mentions and comment resolution.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Good performance with external SQL databases; inherits database performance
product_features.notes: No artificial row limits like Airtable. Performance depends on underlying database.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Full Python support; familiar to data professionals; steeper learning curve for non-programmers
product_features.notes: Python formulas with full standard library. Multi-line formulas. Excel function compatibility.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Relational tables with automatic columns; intuitive reference fields
product_features.notes: SQLite-based with relational references. Auto-generated columns enhance data modeling.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Standard table view with widget-based dashboard layouts
product_features.notes: Focuses on table view + custom widgets/dashboards. Fewer traditional view types than Airtable/Baserow.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Open source with self-hosting option; no lock-in; SQLite export portability
product_features.notes: Self-hosting available free. Excellent for regulated industries and data sovereignty.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Row-level access control available but setup requires authentication configuration
product_features.notes: Row-level access control. Authentication integration options available.

product_features.hci_cost_note: REST API + webhooks + custom widget API; extensible architecture
product_features.notes: Extensible via REST API, webhooks, and custom widgets. OAuth and OIDC support (2026).

product_features.hci_cost_note: Export to CSV or SQLite; no lock-in by design
product_features.notes: Can export full database as SQLite file. CSV export for individual tables. Designed for portability.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Talk-to-build feature generates schema from natural language descriptions
product_features.notes: AI talk-to-build creates database structure from descriptions. Early feature, maturing.

product_features.hci_cost_note: PostgreSQL-native backend; efficient for large datasets
product_features.notes: Built on PostgreSQL for scalability. Handles larger datasets more efficiently than Baserow.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Grid, kanban, calendar, gallery, form views included
product_features.notes: Multiple view types built-in. Comparable to NocoDB feature set.

product_features.hci_cost_note: ISO9001/27001 certified; enterprise-grade compliance
product_features.notes: ISO certifications emphasize enterprise readiness. AGPL Community Edition available.

product_features.hci_cost_note: AI App Builder generates complete apps in 60 seconds from description
product_features.notes: Knack 2.0 (2026) emphasizes AI-driven app generation. Major differentiator vs pure databases.

product_features.hci_cost_note: 20+ field types; connected tables; less emphasis on relational elegance than pure databases
product_features.notes: Supports relational tables, custom fields, form rules. Database is means to app-building end.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Visual form builder with drag-and-drop fields and conditional logic
product_features.notes: Powerful form builder with conditional display, validation, rich field types.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Knack Flows automation platform; 500+ integrations on free tier
product_features.notes: Knack Flows with unlimited flows, 500+ integrations. API available on paid tiers only (500-10k calls/day).

product_features.hci_cost_note: Dashboard and reporting blocks included; visual pivot tables and charts
product_features.notes: Dashboards, pivot tables, bar/column/line/pie/area charts all included on all plans.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Payment processing block available on Pro plan and above
product_features.notes: E-commerce payment integration on Pro plan and above. Differentiator vs pure databases.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Gantt charts, resource management, dependency tracking; complex UI requires training
product_features.notes: Gantt view, timeline, resource planning. Core workflow focus vs pure data.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Advanced reporting and dashboard creation; pivot tables and custom reports
product_features.notes: Reports, dashboards, controlled visibility. Enterprise analytics capabilities.

product_features.hci_cost_note: REST API with 30+ MCP tools; webhooks; official SDKs (Python, Java, Node.js, C#)
product_features.notes: Full REST API, webhooks, MCP integration. Claude integration (2026). Official SDKs available.

product_features.hci_cost_note: Advanced SSO, role-based permissions, workspace governance on higher tiers
product_features.notes: SSO, RBAC, shared team workspaces. Enterprise governance features.

notes: Complete competitive analysis of no-code database/spreadsheet platforms. Seven products analyzed: Airtable (market leader), NocoDB (highest-star OSS alternative), Baserow (compliance/self-hosting play), Grist (Python + spreadsheet), Teable (newer PostgreSQL-native AI entrant), Knack (app builder vs database pure-play), Smartsheet (project management adjacent). MetroGraph's differentiation: metro-map-style *visualization* of schema and relationships. Competitive positioning emphasizes graph/ERD interface as answer to both Airtable's surface-area bloat (hiddenin nested panels) and no-code tools' "chat as UI" anti-pattern. Primary threat level high from Airtable (incumbent moat) and NocoDB (open-source momentum, widest integrations). Key wedges: (1) data engineers managing 30+ tables need visual schema navigation; (2) compliance teams need lineage/provenance transparency; (3) post-AI-generation, teams need to *understand* generated schemas via visual layout. Secondary opportunity: integration layer (MetroGraph as data viz frontend to Baserow/NocoDB/Grist backends).
